item.title: US FDA clears CRISPR-based sickle cell gene therapy
item.description: The agency approved a gene-editing therapy for severe sickle cell disease, the first medicine of its kind to reach the market. The treatment reprograms a patient's blood cells to produce healthy hemoglobin.

item.title: Regulators tighten rules on lab-grown meat labeling
item.description: New guidance will require cultivated meat products to carry clear labels distinguishing them from conventionally farmed meat, a move industry groups say could slow consumer adoption.

item.title: Wearable sensor detects early sepsis hours before symptoms
item.description: In a hospital pilot, a skin patch that continuously monitors inflammatory markers flagged the onset of sepsis an average of six hours earlier than standard vital-sign monitoring.
